cards.title: SQUIRE
cards.concept: earnest young squire in a plain grey tabard and cloth cap, hugging a furled blank banner to his chest with a steady, hopeful smile
cards.hook: founder at day one: carrying the flag of a realm (Compute Labs, 2024) that does not exist yet

cards.title: CARTOGRAPHER
cards.concept: young cartographer in a grey linen coat unrolling a parchment map across his chest whose coastlines are drawn as circuit traces, a quill tucked behind one ear
cards.hook: mapping the uncharted GPU real-world-asset continent he founded the company around

cards.title: TAVERN GAMEKEEPER
cards.concept: tavern gamekeeper in a leather apron over a grey shirt, holding a wooden board-game box with a pair of carved dice resting on the lid
cards.hook: gaming-industry roots at Delysium, rct.AI and Xsolla

cards.title: COIN CLERK
cards.concept: neat counting-house clerk in a grey waistcoat and sleeve garters, holding a small brass balance that weighs a silicon chip against a stack of silver coins
cards.hook: Xsolla's game payments plus the core idea that a GPU is a real, valuable asset

cards.title: APPRENTICE SCRIBE
cards.concept: studious scribe in a simple grey scholar's robe, glasses pushed up his nose, clutching a tall stack of leather-bound books to his chest
cards.hook: UCLA and Caltech student years; his signature glasses

cards.title: BRUIN RANGER
cards.concept: ranger in a green-trimmed leather jerkin and hooded cloak with a small bear-cub familiar perched on his shoulder and a longbow slung behind his head
cards.hook: UCLA Bruins pun: a bear cub as his first familiar

cards.title: QUEST GIVER
cards.concept: friendly quest-giver in a green-hemmed doublet holding up a parchment quest notice, a small green exclamation mark hovering above his head
cards.hook: rct.AI built AI-driven game NPCs; here he is the NPC who hands out the quest

cards.title: CHIP TINKERER
cards.concept: artificer apprentice in a green-strapped work vest, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead above his glasses, holding a small circuit board with one faint green LED
cards.hook: hands-on with the GPUs at the heart of Compute Labs

cards.title: GUILD FOUNDER
cards.concept: young guildmaster in a crisp green-lapelled doublet, holding a freshly signed charter scroll with a green wax seal pressed with a diamond crest
cards.hook: launched Compute Labs in 2024; the diamond crest nods to the CL mark

cards.title: KNIGHT CAPTAIN
cards.concept: knight captain in polished steel plate with a teal cape and a teal diamond crest on the chest, commander's sword held upright before him, eyes calm behind his glasses, faint teal glint on the blade
cards.hook: leads the company from the front, composed and quietly determined

cards.title: STAR SCHOLAR
cards.concept: astronomer-scholar in teal-trimmed midnight robes holding a brass telescope across his chest, glowing teal star charts drifting behind his head
cards.hook: Caltech, home of the Palomar observatory

cards.title: TREATY ENVOY
cards.concept: royal envoy in a sharply tailored dark frock coat with teal lining and a teal diamond lapel pin, holding a sealed treaty scroll that glows faintly teal
cards.hook: his sharp suit and lapel pin; the CEO who closes the deals and partnerships

cards.title: DUNGEON MASTER
cards.concept: game-master sorcerer in ornate violet robes, lenses glowing magenta, conjuring a floating miniature dungeon of violet light above an open rune-covered tome held at his chest
cards.hook: gaming-industry roots: now he is the one who designs the whole world

cards.title: SILICON WARLORD
cards.concept: warlord king in dark violet plate etched with glowing circuit runes, wearing a crown forged from glowing GPU chips, a violet aura crackling around his shoulders
cards.hook: commands the GPUs that power the Compute Labs empire

cards.title: GPU SOVEREIGN
cards.concept: ascended sovereign in gold and white regalia with a blazing sun-disc halo built of radiant GPU dies behind his head, golden chips turning into pure gold light as they orbit his shoulders
cards.hook: the CEO's ultimate vision realised: turning GPU compute into real-world assets, silicon into gold
